title: Ethiopian Lamb Kebabs
description: Tender lamb skewers marinated in a blend of spices and grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of warm naan bread.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim any excess fat

ingredients.name: Quick Injera Bread, torn into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.notes: Traditionally used as a base for Ethiopian dishes

ingredients.name: Grilled onion, diced
ingredients.notes: Caramelize the onions before adding to the lamb

ingredients.name: Roasted red bell pepper, diced
ingredients.notes: Char the pepper over an open flame for a smoky flavor

ingredients.name: Fresh cilantro, chopped
ingredients.notes: Add a burst of freshness to the dish

ingredients.name: Spiced olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a combination of olive oil, garlic, and spices to marinate the lamb

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice for brightness

ingredients.name: Ginger, grated
ingredients.notes: Add a hint of warm spice to the lamb

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Use ground cumin for a deep, earthy flavor

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Add a smoky depth to the lamb

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together spiced olive oil, lemon juice, ginger, cumin, and paprika.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and toss to coat.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the lamb, onion, bell pepper, and cilantro onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve the lamb skewers with warm injera bread and a side of your choice.
